title: Flesh
author: David Szalay
description: Winner of the 2025 Booker Prize. Following István from a Hungarian housing estate through the army, prison, wealth, and loss, Szalay tells a spare, unsettling story of a man who says little and is shaped by everything around him.

file: A Clockwork Orange by Anthony Burgess.avif
title: A Clockwork Orange
author: Anthony Burgess
description: Fifteen-year-old Alex loves violence, Beethoven, and his own slang, until the state tries to cure him. A dark, inventive dystopia about free will, morality, and whether goodness that is forced can be goodness at all.

file: Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen.avif
title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy misjudge each other in a world of money, class, and marriage. Austen's witty, sharp-eyed classic of first impressions and second chances.

file: A Man Called Ove by Fredrik Backman.avif
title: A Man Called Ove
author: Fredrik Backman
description: Ove is a grumpy, rule-obsessed widower who has given up on life, until a boisterous new family moves in next door. A funny and deeply moving story about loneliness, community, and unexpected friendship.

title: நிச்சயிக்கப்பட்டப் பெண்
author: ஆன்டன் செகாவ் (தமிழில்: எம்.கோபாலகிருஷ்ணன்)
description: நாடியா தன் நிச்சயதார்த்த வாழ்க்கையின் வெறுமையை உணர்ந்து புதிய வாழ்க்கையைத் தேடிப் புறப்படும் கதை. செகாவின் கடைசிச் சிறுகதையான இது, சமூகக் கட்டுப்பாடுகளிலிருந்து ஒரு இளம்பெண்ணின் விடுதலையை மென்மையாகச் சித்தரிக்கிறது.
